description: This file defines extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization using System.Text.Json in a C# project. It provides methods to convert objects to JSON strings and vice versa, with custom options set for case-insensitive property names.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: FromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an object of type T, using configured JsonSerializerOptions.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into a JSON string, using configured JsonSerializerOptions.
